title: Adelaide International Bird Sanctuary National Park
get_in:
{{mapframe}}{{mapshape|wikidata=Q19870520}}
From [[Adelaide]] City, head north onto the M2 North-South Motorway, and exit the expressway at A1 Port Wakefield Highway. From there, it's a divided highway and after {{km|35.4}}, exit (or bear left) onto the small town of Dublin, and turn left and head down for {{km|8}} until you've arrived at Adelaide International Bird Sanctuary National Park.
